conservative.description: High safety margin: refuses earlier on borderline unusual inputs.

balanced.description: Recommended default: balanced trade-off between detection of true unknowns and false alarm rate.

bold.description: Permissive: minimizes false alarms on familiar crops; reserves refusal for severe anomalies.

limitations: OOD gate operates strictly over feature subset: ['temperature', 'humidity', 'rainfall'].
Thresholds calibrated on 5-fold out-of-fold training distributions.
Higher overlap between crops in lower dimensional subspaces than in 7D joint space.
